# RealizeOS

> RealizeOS is what AI agents connect to: a company's memory, rules and approvals, running on the company's own server. Bring any agent, keep your company's brain, stay in control. Built by Realization for real-estate development, architecture and planning, and construction firms (Israel and Portugal/EU; Hebrew, English and Portuguese). The software is free to download under BSL 1.1; Realization's practice audits, implements and operates it.

Key facts:

- RealizeOS is not another chat agent. Claude.ai and Claude Desktop (custom connector with OAuth sign-in), Claude Code, n8n and other MCP clients connect to it through its built-in MCP server (Streamable HTTP on /mcp).
- The company brain (FABRIC) is stored as plain files the company owns and can take with it.
- Governed action: agents read freely; writes go through approvals and a trust ladder. An approved action runs exactly once and reports back; on errors, writes are blocked (fail closed).
- Every answer can show a "What I used" trail with numbered source citations such as [S1].
- Five roles (owner, admin, operator, user, viewer) and per-user venture limits apply in the dashboard, the REST API and MCP.
- One field pack ships today: real-estate-developer (tender requirements register, payment request check against contract milestones, investor report).
- Agent tool use requires Claude. Ollama is supported for local chat without tools.
- RealizeOS does not replace an appraiser, a lawyer or an engineer's sign-off. It prepares the work and shows its sources; people decide.
- Offer: RealizeOS is free. Audit Sprint €495, credited toward implementation. Implementation and Operate (retainer) are fixed in scope and quoted after the audit.

## Guide

- [Getting Started](https://realizeos.ai/guide/getting-started): install with Docker, Python, npx or the Windows one-liner
- [Connect Your Agent](https://realizeos.ai/guide/connect-your-agent): Claude.ai / Claude Desktop connector via OAuth, Claude Code, n8n, reverse proxy, troubleshooting
- [Approvals & the Trail](https://realizeos.ai/guide/approvals-and-trail): what waits for a person, how to approve, citations
- [Users, Roles & Ventures](https://realizeos.ai/guide/users-and-roles): users.yaml, the five roles, venture limits
- [Field Packs](https://realizeos.ai/guide/field-packs): the real-estate developer pack
- [Hebrew & Right-to-Left](https://realizeos.ai/guide/hebrew-and-rtl): venture locale and RTL dashboard
- [Configuration](https://realizeos.ai/guide/configuration): .env, feature flags, trust ladder, MCP, LLM providers
- [Self-Hosting & Production](https://realizeos.ai/guide/self-hosting): production settings, HTTPS, reverse proxy
- [CLI & REST API](https://realizeos.ai/guide/connectors): operator CLI and REST endpoints
